headline: Adecoagro Owners Acquire Benetton's Landholdings in Argentina
summary: An investor group led by Mariano Bosch has acquired over 900,000 hectares of land previously owned by Benetton across the Argentine provinces of Buenos Aires, Río Negro, Chubut, and Santa Cruz, focusing primarily on ovine production.
why: Adecoagro is a major Latin American agricultural company, and large-scale land acquisitions in the region significantly alter asset consolidation and agricultural output capacity in South America.

impacts.name: Adecoagro
impacts.why: A major land acquisition expands the operational footprint and asset base of the acquiring group.
